text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross! Victory goes to Tamamo 
Cross!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She delivered a run truly worthy of the 
number one fan vote! Unquestionable 
strength and undisputed popularity!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
ALLLRIIIGHTTTTT!!! How d'ya like 
THATTTT!!!
(UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
As long as you've got the will, there's 
nothin' you can't do! You can bounce back 
from rock bottom!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are ya watchin', Pops?!! I did it--!!
(UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

"By now, every fan knew Tamamo Cross's 
upbringing. The roar of the crowd was like 
thunder following a bolt of lightning."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Everything's fine now. Dad will be... our 
home will surely be...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(...Oguri, did ya see that? My run. This 
is the "White Lightning".)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(I run for the sake of my family. What do 
you run for? What are you aiming for...?)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

Watching Tamamo Cross are Oguri Cap, and 
one other person...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the deal with this emotional 
drama~?! You're gonna make me cry, 
dammit...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tama, be as good of a daughter as 
you can! Won't be so easy next year."

Sniffling and snuffling, Inari One walked 
away.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It went just like you said it 
would.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I can win. From here on out too... 
without fail...! I'm so glad I didn't quit 
racing...!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can still keep winning.
Yeah, we can still win more!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right. The real deal starts right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class autumn GⅠs! If ya don't 
make your mark there, ya can't say ya 
reached the top!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: First... let's head over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ready, and...!

They shouted simultaneously. It was one of 
the most prestigious races held during the 
autumn GⅠ season.

If she wins the Tenno Sho (Autumn), her 
father will surely be thrilled. The next 
race was decided in an instant.
And so, a few nights later—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dad, for real!? You got discharged from 
the hospital!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, you're right. Hahaha, after seein' a 
run like that, I can't just sit around 
takin' it easy.""

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I reckon I showed 'em too. My 
'lightning.'"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Lightning?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's right! Come to think of it, 
Dad was at work...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. He works so fast they call him 
'Lightning.' Nobody can work as deftly as 
my dad."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Her running might take after her mother, 
but that lightning spark just might be 
from me."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dad... Yeah, you're right. If Dad's the 
original lightning, then I'm...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...A second Lightning, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Dad. There's someone out there... 
someone I really wanna strike with this 
lightning.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me! From here on out, 
I'm really gonna go all out!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm lookin' forward to it. Make 
sure ya don't catch a cold, Tama."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Autumn... First up is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). And then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
From here on, no more worrying about my 
family! This is the start of my brand new 
season!!
